These codes can direct guests to a brief, optional survey, letting you gather insights on comfort and overall experience without being intrusive.

6. Maintaining Privacy & Transparency  
 • Non-Intrusive Data Collection: Emphasize that all data is aggregated and anonymized—focusing on patterns (like frequency of adjustments in climate or lighting) rather than individual preferences.  
 • Informative Welcome Materials: Include a gentle note in your welcome guide explaining that smart systems help create a continually optimized, immersive environment. Reinforce that guest privacy is fully respected.

By thoughtfully blending immersive design—through adaptive lighting, themed decor, interactive digital interfaces, and integrated environmental sensors—with detailed yet non-invasive feedback systems, you can create an engaging, comfortable space that delights guests while providing you with valuable, aggregated insights for continual improvement.
